# Halloway Ridge Programme Glossary

**Authority:** secondary — internal reference, maintained by the programme office
**Last reviewed:** 2031-03-01

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Frit | The porous ceramic tip through which soil water equilibrates with the probe's internal cavity. |
| Volumetric water content | The fraction of a soil sample's bulk volume occupied by water, reported as a percentage. |
| Two-point calibration | Calibration against a dry standard and a saturated standard in a single session. |
| Sulfate crust | A mineral deposit that forms on a frit in sulfate-rich soil and impedes hydraulic contact. |
| Variance | A written Board authorisation to operate outside a permit condition. |
| Trial register | The bound log in which every calibration and maintenance event is recorded. |
| Control block | An uninstrumented plot used as the comparison baseline for yield analysis. |
| Condition breach | Any failure to satisfy a numbered condition of the operating permit. |

## Usage notes

1. "Drift" always refers to a change in reported value with no change in the
   measured quantity. It is not a synonym for error.
2. "Uplift" is reserved for yield comparisons against the control block.
3. "Preliminary" is not a softener. It records that a result has not been
   replicated across a second season.
